questions.text: Describe the image in as much detail as you can.
questions.sampleAnswer: This picture shows a family cooking together in a bright kitchen. On the left there is a large window, and in the foreground there is a wooden counter with some vegetables and a cutting board on it. Two adults are standing behind the counter; the man on the right seems to be stirring something, perhaps a soup, in a pot on the stove. A young child is standing next to them, and it looks as though she is helping. The atmosphere seems warm and relaxed, so I imagine they are preparing a weekend meal together.
